Round 19: all actual moves have a defense value; zero means no defense, without a separate defense-presence flag; existing comparison, exclusive matching and explicit exceptions still apply

Round 21: successful self-bi deals 10000 to qualifying targets and keeps defense <=infinity; L03 survives LiQiang 10000. Trigger success does not require a final kill

Round 22: Reflect and Absorb have defense <=100; above 100, the incoming attack is neither defended nor reflected/absorbed. Combining G02/G10, failure is per incoming attack, not a whole-turn disable. L05/L06 cannot counter LiQiang 10000.
Round 23: R04 confirmed, reflection targets only the original attacker; its valid kill belongs to the reflector. Original attacks remain effective in the same round.
Round 23: M12 confirmed, one absorber facing Three plus Pragon receives 3+2 DD and pays the cast cost once, net +4 DD. Sum distinct eligible incoming attack gains; do not infer Charge/Cloud rules.

Round 24: reflection is evaluated independently for each attacker; the returned attack value equals that incoming attack value, targeting only its original attacker when the reflection condition holds. Fixed 10000 return proposal was not adopted.

Round 24: M13 confirmed, two Charge actors retain prior DD but gain no new DD; two Absorb actors each independently gain 1 DD from each charger, total 2 DD minus one cast cost, net +1 DD each. No repeated deduction from chargers.

Round 26: user accepted four-phase resolution and defense phase distinction. Current master was rewritten and all 31 legacy entries cataloged with explicit phase fields and evidence statuses; this does not approve all code-candidate numbers or unresolved matchups.

Round 27: Cloud shares Absorb defense <=100 and special matching without gaining opponent DD; every charger loses only this round gain, and each legal Cloud cast gains exactly one lightning. In M14 B/C die to D Three, not to Cloud charge denial.

Round 29: any Shell/XiaoBei pair cancels only the attacks between that pair, preserving each attack on third parties and not ending the round as a game draw.

Round 29: XiaoBei loses against Charge through direct elimination while Charge ordinary attack remains zero. Preserving the accepted loss outcome implies XiaoBei attack on that charger is inactive by target matching, not by death; other targets remain affected.

Round 29: S01-S04 derive complete multi-player outcomes; G21 unsuccessful zero-DD LiQiang follows Charge effects without changing its actual move identity. Source-specific costs and general candidate numbers are not approved by these matchup confirmations.
